description.zh: 座席接听时自动在双侧播放开场白语音，指定语音变量值；企业语音库里的语音变量值
description.en: Specifies the voice file from the enterprise voice library that plays as an opening statement for both parties when an agent answers a call.

description.zh:
座席接听时自动在双侧播放开场白语音类型，默认为3。
- 1：公共语音库；
- 2：企业语音库，静态话术；
- 3：企业语音库，动态话术（座席号），传bridgeVoicePath后生效。
description.en:
The type of the opening statement audio to play when an agent answers a call. This parameter takes effect only if `BridgeVoicePath` is specified. Default value: 3. Valid values:

- 1: A file from the public voice library.

- 2: A static script from the enterprise voice library.

- 3: A dynamic script from the enterprise voice library (which can include variables such as the agent ID).
The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 批次Id；传此值表示在批次中增加号码
description.en: The ID of the batch. If you specify this parameter, the numbers are added to the existing batch.

description.zh:
是否自动启动任务，默认为0。
- 0：不自动启动
- 1：自动启动
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically start the task after the import is complete. Default value: 0. Valid values:

- 0: Does not automatically start the task.

- 1: Automatically starts the task.

description.zh:
是否排重，默认为1。
- 0：不排重
- 1：任务内排重
- 2：导入号码排重
- 3：批次内排重

> - 任务内排重与批次内排重不能同时支持，如果中途切换，则从本次切换开始进行排重。
description.en:
Specifies the deduplication policy. Default value: 1. Valid values:

- 0: Disables deduplication.

- 1: Deduplicates numbers within the current task.

- 2: Deduplicates numbers in the current import.

- 3: Deduplicates numbers within the current batch.

> * Deduplication within a task and deduplication within a batch cannot be enabled at the same time. If you switch between these policies, the new policy applies to subsequent imports.

description.zh: 优先级；默认0，值越大越优先，最大999999
description.en: The priority of the batch. The default value is 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority. The maximum value is 999999.

description.zh: 任务号码列表；CtiLinkTaskTel中只有Tel是必选字段，长度大小不超过8MB 注：获取导入失败明细，需配置[事件推送](../字段定义/推送变量和值/预测外呼导入号码失败推送变量.md)
description.en: A list of numbers to import for the task. The size of the request body cannot exceed 8 MB. In a `CtiLinkTaskTel` object, only the `Tel` field is required. Note: Configure [event notification](../%E5%AD%97%E6%AE%B5%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89/%E6%8E%A8%E9%80%81%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F%E5%92%8C%E5%80%BC/%E9%A2%84%E6%B5%8B%E5%A4%96%E5%91%BC%E5%AF%BC%E5%85%A5%E5%8F%B7%E7%A0%81%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%E6%8E%A8%E9%80%81%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F.md) to receive details about failed imports.

description.zh: 备选号码，tel呼叫不通时，呼叫备选号码最多支持8个，号码之间用英文逗号","分隔
description.en: A comma-separated list of up to eight backup numbers to call if the primary number (specified by `Tel`) is unreachable.

description.zh: 电话号对应的外显号码
description.en: The caller ID to display for the phone number.

description.zh: 使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，使用此参数是clid参数无效
description.en: Your account must support routing by identifier to use this parameter. If you specify this parameter, the `Clid` parameter becomes invalid.

description.zh: 优先级，默认为0，值越大优先级越高，最大999999
description.en: The priority of the number. The default value is 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority. The maximum value is 999999.
Custom properties for the number, in JSON format.

descriptions.zh:
按批次导入号码，一次导入一个批次。

限制：一个批次最多10w个号码，一个任务最多100w个号码，一个企业最多1000w个号码。

可创建批次数：≤ 10 万个。
可导入号码数：≤100 万个。
单批次可导入号码数：≤ 10 万个。
超额处理：当触发上述任一限制时，本次请求失败。

提供「删除任务内号码」接口：业务平台可根据实际情况定期自动删除任务内已完成的批次或号码。
删除任务内号码后，平台已呼叫过的通话记录明细、录音文件会继续保留。
descriptions.en:
Import numbers by batch. Each request processes a single batch.

Limits: A maximum of 100,000 numbers per batch, 1,000,000 numbers per task, and 10,000,000 numbers per enterprise.

The maximum number of batches is 100,000. Any request that exceeds these limits will fail.

The `Delete numbers in a task` API lets your business platform periodically and automatically delete completed batches or numbers from a task. Even after these numbers are deleted, the platform retains the call detail records and recording files for any calls made using them.
